summary: Root cause: the inline style transform translateY(110%) was parsed by GSAP into y: 71.5px, which the show tween (yPercent only) never cleared. StickyBuyBar now ships visibility:hidden only; useGSAP sets the resting state { y: 0, yPercent: 110, visibility: hidden }, shows with { y: 0, yPercent: 0 } (360 ms sk.out) and hides back to the same state; reduced motion places the bar on screen at once and fades only opacity. While shown the bar registers with useBottomInset (scroll-padding-bottom + focus clearance, WCAG 2.4.11). aria-hidden/inert follow the shown state as before (D259).

summary: Card part (the 3 px header overflow is VIS-03 of shell-perf; measured 0 px now). The card footer's size container wraps only the footer, so @min-[17rem] measures the body column instead of the whole card: in the 104 px list layout at 320 px the price and a full-width „U korpu“ stack (before: the card was ≥ 17rem, so price + button sat side by side in a ~180 px column and the button clipped). OEM line wraps (break-words) instead of truncate; names are not clamped in the list layout (3 lines in the grid); the inline StockBadge may wrap (chip variant stays one line), so the stock line no longer clips under the 1.4.12 text-spacing override. The container sits on the footer only because container-type implies layout containment, which would trap the name link's card-wide ::after (D260).
